d:
Two friends lost their lives in a tragic road accident in Jalandhar, Punjab.
They were returning home after attending a friend's birthday party in the early hours of Sunday.
Their Volkswagen car crashed into a stationary Municipal Corporation tractor-trolley on a flyover near Police Lines. One of the deceased, Vidit Olak, was the nephew of singer Yo Yo Honey Singh and son of Speed Records owner Dinesh Olak.
The second victim was identified as Aarav Talwar, son of the owner of Pappy Sweets.
